sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach come into this fixture in excellent form, unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W), while Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five games (L-L-L-L-L). This should present a strong opportunity for the league leaders to extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town at home, looking to build on their recent draw and maintain pressure on Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form, host Eccleshall in a meeting between two teams occupying the upper reaches of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash. Bilston Town (6th) travel to Foley Meir (13th), while New Mills host Market Drayton Town (10th) — both these fixtures involve teams fighting to consolidate their league positions. Shawbury United host Barnton in a fixture between sides struggling with recent form; Shawbury are on a five-game losing streak while Barnton have shown more resilience. Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town, a meeting of two of the division's weakest teams, while Crewe travel to Allscott Heath in another lower-table encounter. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with Widnes bottom of the league winless.
